title: The Gate That Held Everyone Back
theme: A changed arrangement helps the people waiting at a gate.
audience_intent: Original fictional fable for a general teen/adult audience. Not a real incident or an engineering tutorial.
narration: Every time I reached for my cart, the gate came down. I tried again, and the whole line waited with me. Then I noticed the empty counterweight basket. I took the side steps and filled it with loose stones. The gate rose and stayed open. I rolled through. Behind me, the whole line started moving.
